title: Filter hierarchical paths after deletions
description_html:
You are given:

  • An array of strings representing hierarchical paths, e.g. ["California", "California/San Francisco", "California/San Francisco/7th Street"].
  • A second array of strings representing paths to delete, e.g. ["California/San Francisco"].

Each string is a path in a hierarchy, with levels separated by /. When a path is deleted, that path and all of its descendant paths are removed. Return the remaining paths.

Example

paths     = ["California", "California/San Francisco", "California/San Francisco/7th Street"]
delete    = ["California/San Francisco"]
----
output    = ["California"]

Deleting California/San Francisco also removes its descendant California/San Francisco/7th Street; California survives.

Prefix-based pruning over a path hierarchy (cf. LC 1233 Remove Sub-Folders). See Notes.
